subject: AWS co-sell launch sprint — customer schedule & mutual action plan
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@solushealth.com>
Cc: AWS Channel Manager <aws-channel@amazon.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: AWS co-sell launch sprint — customer schedule & mutual action plan

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our conversation, the AWS co-sell team and Redwood would like to run a short launch sprint with Solus Health to align success criteria, preliminary procurement runway, and an internal decision calendar that will let AWS include the opportunity in the next co-sell window.

Proposed agenda (45–60 min):
- 15 min: solution overview & key outcomes (Redwood + AWS)
- 20 min: mutual action plan / procurement milestones (customer + Redwood)
- 10–15 min: decision calendar and exec approvals / open risks

Would Wednesday 10/13 10:30–11:15 PT or Thursday 10/14 11:00–11:45 PT work for you and Raj? If neither, please propose two times that week. I'll loop in the AWS channel manager and Karthik for technical mapping.

Attached: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (starter) and solution-arch-diagram.pdf. We’ll update the MAP after the sprint.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[e] evelyn.hart@redwood.com | [m] (555) 867-1133

[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: solution-arch-diagram.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@solushealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@solushealth.com>, AWS Channel Manager <aws-channel@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell launch sprint — customer schedule & mutual action plan

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks — Wednesday 10/13 10:30 PT works for us. Raj and I can join, and we'll invite our procurement lead, Mia Gomez, to cover timeline constraints.

A couple of asks ahead of the sprint:
- Can you include a one-page summary of data residency and logging behavior for Redwood Private? Our security team will want to confirm audit/log capabilities before the sprint.
- Please send an editable version of the mutual action plan so we can add procurement dates.

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Alyssa Turner
Director of Product | Solus Health
alyssa.turner@solushealth.com

On Tue, 12 Oct 2027 at 09:05 Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Alyssa,
> 
> Thanks again for the time on Friday...

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Prep: Solus Health sprint (W 10/13 10:30 PT) — roles & pre-read

Team,

Quick prep for tomorrow's sprint with Solus Health (customer confirmed). Key asks and owner callouts:
- Karthik: lead technical mapping and answer quantization/hosting questions (Redwood Private vs Dedicated). Please bring the 1-pager on data residency and audit logging that Alyssa asked for.
- Sean: lead the procurement/runway discussion and capture dates in the MAP. Bring the standard procurement checklist and a rough SOW timeline (Q4 target).
- I'll run the MAP live and cover the co-sell eligibility criteria with the AWS channel rep.

Attachments are the MAP and the solution diagram I sent externally. During the call we should:
1) Capture the 'must have' procurement dates from Mia (procurement lead).
2) Confirm whether Solus needs an on-prem option for a proof-of-concept or whether VPC-private deployment will suffice.
3) Get a named exec sponsor and target decision date to include in the AWS submission.

I'll send the calendar invite with dial-in and the AWS channel manager's contact. Let me know if you need any other artifacts.

Thanks,
Evelyn

[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: solution-arch-diagram.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Channel Manager <aws-channel@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prep: Solus Health sprint (W 10/13 10:30 PT) — roles & pre-read

All good — I'll bring the residency one-pager and a quick sketch of host/quant options. Sean, I tossed draft procurement dates into the MAP and linked a shared calendar event for the sprint: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=aws-sprint-90321

If Mia wants an on-prem POC, we have a simple checklist to scope infra and timeline; happy to run that as a follow-up workshop.

Karthik
Lead Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
